name: @sahelflow/marketing-remotion
description: SahelFlow production marketing and product-demonstration films built with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run generate:score && npm run generate:v3:score && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:launch: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Launch-60 renders/sahelflow-premium-launch-60.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:social: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Social-30 renders/sahelflow-premium-social-30.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:vertical: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Vertical-15 renders/sahelflow-premium-vertical-15.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:demo: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Demo-90 renders/sahelflow-premium-demo-90.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:preview: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:social
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:social && npm run render:launch && npm run render:demo
scripts.render:v3:hero: npm run prepare:v3 && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Hero-65 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-hero-65.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite
scripts.render:v3:social: npm run prepare:v3 && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Social-30 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-social-30.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite
scripts.render:v3:vertical: npm run prepare:v3 && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Vertical-15 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-vertical-15.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite
scripts.render:v3:demo: npm run prepare:v3 && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Demo-120 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-demo-120.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite
scripts.render:v3:loop: npm run prepare:v3 && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Landing-Loop-12 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-landing-loop-12.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted --overwrite
scripts.render:v3:all: npm run prepare:v3 && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Vertical-15 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-vertical-15.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Social-30 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-social-30.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Hero-65 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-hero-65.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Demo-120 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-demo-120.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --overwrite && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-V3-Landing-Loop-12 renders/v3/sahelflow-v3-landing-loop-12.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=13 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted --overwrite
